Dexter (Japanese: ビック Vick) is a character in . He is the announcer and one of the judges of the Pokémon Super Contests. His appearance is designed after the .

==In the core series games==
 
Dexter appears as the master of ceremonies and one of the Pokémon Super Contest Judges in Hearthome City, Sinnoh in . He appears to be a kind man who genuinely enjoys his work, despite limited interaction with the . His input appears to be somewhat more important in the Acting Competition than Keira's or Jordan's, as raising his Voltage to maximum gains the 's eight points instead of five. Also, he sits in the center of the three judges and has a heart under his name.

His appearance looks somewhat different in the to the . In the games, he appears as a somewhat tall man with a full head of white hair, wearing a bow-tie.

==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
 
==== ====
Dexter was first seen in the Hearthome City Contest Hall when arrived and determinedly swore an oath to partake in the next day's . After was given a Poffin Case and created various mixes of excellent Poffins for her that brought up 's Coolness stat high, which impressed Dexter, she saw opposition in several jealous contestants whose intervention nearly had her backing out before Diamond brought her spirits up, after which she managed to win nevertheless, utilizing a combination of , , , and .

A young Dexter was later seen in a picture with a younger Johanna in Diamond's home. He was also seen with his fellow judges at the Lost Tower after having been sent there because of the fight between and that caused time and space to distort.

===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!===
Dexter appeared in Beauty Contest: The Pokémon Super Contest!!, where he was seen judging the that Hareta and had entered. He was highly tolerant of their antics, which included being hit by a and combination by Hareta's Piplup. However, when Jun's Staravia blew his hat off with , exposing his bald head, he lost his temper and disqualified both Jun and Hareta from the competition.
